normal_public_route.field_scope: unqualified global public search; field qualifiers are not used because bounded current direct GET probes rewrote ':'

constraint.enforced_pre_submission_rule: Every cell has submitted_characters <= 500 and is UTF-8/BOM-free with no terminal newline.
constraint.server_limit_status: not asserted; direct 501-ASCII probe was accepted and echoed, so 500 is treated as the normal visible input limit only.

partitions.source_expression_form: parenthesized global all-metadata Boolean expression; whitespace AND; uppercase OR; double-quoted multiword/hyphenated finite literals and bare single alphanumeric finite tokens; no field qualifier or wildcard
partitions.split_proof: Let O be the OR of all atoms in split_block and O_j the disjoint ordered cell chunks. Each cell is (other required blocks AND O_j). Because OR_j O_j = O, OR_j(other AND O_j) = other AND O; thus the stable-paper-ID union of all cells is lossless. Pair-rule atoms are an explicit distributive expansion of each dictionary left-OR/right-OR pair rule.
partitions.stable_paper_id_union_rule: After two complete passes per cell, union sets by canonical event-code/paper-number pair; preserve every cell_id for each ID; never infer a union from counts; any failed cell makes the partition total null.
